name: Sajeebit ID Card Generator
author: sajeebit

sections.description:
Sajeebit ID Card Generator helps schools, offices, and clubs create printable ID cards directly from the WordPress admin.

It is a self-contained free plugin. Card data stays in your WordPress database. No external ID-card APIs or paid PDF services are required — print from the browser or save as PDF.

Official website: https://sajeebit-id-card-generator.sajeebit.com/

Features

  • Organization profile (name, logo, address, phone, footer text)
  • 100+ premium templates — 16 layout styles × 15 color themes (240 designs)
  • Layouts include Classic, Split, Stripe, Badge, Portrait, Ribbon, Minimal, Band, Wave, Geometric, Chevron, Mosaic, Hex, Diagonal, Elegant, Corners
  • Live template preview while editing colors and fields
  • Card holder records (photo, ID number, designation, department, blood group, dates, status)
  • Search and status filters
  • Single-card and bulk print view
  • Browser print / Save as PDF
  • Optional delete-all-data on uninstall (disabled by default)
  • Capability checks, nonces, prepared SQL

Documentation

Full documentation: https://sajeebit-id-card-generator.sajeebit.com/docs.html

Quick start:

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Open Settings and set your organization name and logo.
  3. On Templates, click Install 100+ premium pack, then pick a design.
  4. Add cards with photos.
  5. Open Print and print or save as PDF.

Privacy

  • No remote tracking
  • No analytics injection
  • No phoning home
  • Optional data deletion on uninstall (disabled by default)
sections.installation:
1. Install Sajeebit ID Card Generator from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Sajeebit ID Cards from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure organization settings.
  5. Install the premium template pack and customize.
  6. Add card holders and print.

More detail: https://sajeebit-id-card-generator.sajeebit.com/docs.html
sections.faq:
Where can I find documentation?

Visit https://sajeebit-id-card-generator.sajeebit.com/docs.html

How many templates are included?

The premium pack includes 240 templates (16 layouts × 15 color themes). Use Install 100+ premium pack on the Templates screen.

What card size is supported?

Templates default to CR80 (85.60 × 53.98 mm landscape, or portrait for vertical layouts). You can change width and height per template.

Can I export PDF?

Yes. Use the Print screen and choose “Save as PDF” in your browser print dialog.

Does this require an external service?

No. Everything runs inside WordPress.

Is my data deleted when I uninstall?

Only if you enable “Delete all plugin tables and settings when the plugin is deleted” in Settings. It is off by default.
